blocks.html: Where three or fewer washing machines are provided, at least one shall comply with ICC A117.1, including Section 611 (Washing Machines and Clothes Dryers), and shall be accessible. Where more than three washing machines are provided, at least two shall comply with ICC A117.1, including Section 611 and shall be accessible.
